parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Caller-generated unique key (a UUID per logical submit) that makes a retried request safe (ADR 0018). Postgres is the only runtime, so the check is on in every deployment: a missing or empty key is answered with 400 `idempotency-key-required`; a replay with the same key and the same body returns the original response, while the same key with a different body is 422 `idempotency-key-reused`.

parameters.name: lpn
parameters.description: The container's license plate (the carton SSCC, or an internal `LPN-<site>-<id>`).
